basic_details.job_title: Sikkim University Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Microbiology, School of Life Sciences, Sikkim University is hiring 2 Senior Research Fellows (SRF) for a Department of Biotechnology (Government of India)-funded research project at ₹42,000 per month plus HRA @ 8%. The appointment is for 5 months. The essential qualification is a Master's Degree in Natural Sciences/Agriculture Sciences from a UGC recognised university. Applications must reach the Principal Investigator, Dr. Nagendra Thakur, before 15 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates apply with an application letter, Bio-data, CSIR/ICAR/DBT-JRF-NET/GATE certificate and other supporting documents, addressed in favour of Dr. Nagendra Thakur, Associate Professor & Head, Department of Microbiology (PI). The applications must reach the PI before 15 November 2026. The notice prints no postal address, email address or form for sending the application.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Applications are accepted only if they reach the PI before 15 November 2026.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About Sikkim University Department of Microbiology
content_sections.text: The Department of Microbiology is part of the School of Life Sciences, Sikkim University. The project is led by Dr. Nagendra Thakur, Associate Professor and Head of the Department of Microbiology, who is the Principal Investigator (PI). The Department of Biotechnology (Government of India) funds the project.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Master's Degree in Natural Sciences/Agriculture Sciences from the UGC recognised university. Desirable qualification: MSc Microbiology. The notice asks applicants to send a CSIR/ICAR/DBT-JRF-NET/GATE certificate along with the application. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly emoluments are ₹ 42000 plus HRA @ 8%. The duration of appointment is 5 months. The notice states that the appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Sikkim University Senior Research fellow
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates apply with an application letter, Bio-data, CSIR/ICAR/DBT-JRF-NET/GATE certificate and other supporting documents, addressed in favour of Dr. Nagendra Thakur, Associate Professor & Head, Department of Microbiology (PI). The applications must reach the PI before 15 November 2026. The notice prints no postal address, email address or form for sending the application. Application letter Bio-data CSIR/ICAR/DBT-JRF-NET/GATE certificate Other supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed candidates will be called for interview. The notice does not mention the interview date, venue or mode.

rows.event: Last date: applications must reach the PI

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Applications are accepted only if they reach the PI before 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Research Fellow posts are vacant at Sikkim University?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 2 Senior Research Fellow (SRF) posts in the Department of Microbiology for a Department of Biotechnology-funded project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Sikkim University SRF post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the PI, Dr. Nagendra Thakur, before 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Sikkim University SRF post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Master's Degree in Natural Sciences/Agriculture Sciences from the UGC recognised university. MSc Microbiology is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the Sikkim University Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are ₹ 42000 plus HRA @ 8%.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the ₹42,000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states the pay as ₹ 42000 plus HRA @ 8%.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Sikkim University SRF post?
faq.answer: Send an application letter, Bio-data, CSIR/ICAR/DBT-JRF-NET/GATE certificate and other supporting documents in favour of Dr. Nagendra Thakur, Associate Professor & Head, Department of Microbiology (PI), so that they reach the PI before 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for the Sikkim University SRF post?
faq.answer: Only short-listed candidates will be called for interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Sikkim University SRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The duration of appointment is 5 months, and the notice says the appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
